python -c "
from semver import VersionInfo

# Test with all fields
v = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build')
print('Test 1 - All fields:')
print(f'Iteration: {list(v)}')
print(f'Unpacking: major, minor, patch, prerelease, build = {list(v)}')

# Test with None values
v2 = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)
print('\nTest 2 - No prerelease or build:')
print(f'Iteration: {list(v2)}')

# Test unpacking directly
major, minor, patch, prerelease, build = v
print('\nTest 3 - Direct unpacking:')
print(f'major={major}, minor={minor}, patch={patch}, prerelease={prerelease}, build={build}')

# Verify order is correct
print('\nTest 4 - Order verification:')
result = list(v)
assert result == [1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build'], f'Expected [1, 2, 3, alpha, build], got {result}'
print('Order is correct!')
"
